tools.name: get_rye_consensus
tools.description: Look up one rye whiskey by name (or RyeCentral review URL/handle) and return its RyeCentral Consensus Score out of 5, confidence band (Strong / Solid / Early), confidence percent, number of published sources, last-verified date, key specs and current price range, plus the citation to show the user.

tools.name: search_rye_consensus
tools.description: Search and rank rye whiskeys reviewed by RyeCentral. Filter by name keywords, brand, confidence band, minimum score and maximum price; sort by score (default), confidence, price or name. Returns up to 25 bottles, each with its RyeCentral Consensus Score, confidence and citation.
